Privacy Policy

Updated September 17, 2026

This notice explains the showing-request form on this independently hosted property landing page.

Information and purpose

The form collects your name, email address, phone number, optional message, and consent selections to respond to your property inquiry and arrange a showing. Marketing calls/texts require the separate optional consent described on the form.

Who receives your request

Your submission is processed by Vercel and sent through Mailgun to the listing team at dianapagomez@gmail.com and miamihomesbyred@gmail.com. Your email is used as the reply-to address. The email includes your consent selections, submission time, source, and disclosure version. This form does not maintain a separate lead database; email copies and service-provider records may be retained by the recipients and providers. Hosting and email providers may process technical information to operate and protect their services.

Your choices

Leave marketing consent unchecked if you do not want to opt in. To ask about your information, request deletion, or withdraw marketing consent, contact Diana at dianapagomez@gmail.com or 305-794-7294. Do not include sensitive financial or identification information in your message.

Keller Williams policies

For information about KW’s own websites and services, read the official Keller Williams Privacy Policy. This independent page uses Vercel and Mailgun rather than KW’s website form infrastructure.
